title: Nine Parts Paper
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：book　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 book 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to bind ① a book she could not read, and she said the reading was the whole of the lesson. The ② book, meaning the volume and not the story, was three hundred pages and was carried by whoever came last; a book, she said, is the only thing in a library that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ book in that shelf had the same spine, and the ④ book at the front, meaning the one the librarian kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mended properly. A book, my grandmother said, is nine parts paper and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the paper is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ book was the whole of the summer, meaning the story it held and not the volume. The ⑥ book, meaning the story and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody borrows and nobody questions; a book, he said, is either something you bind or the only word that means both a volume and a story. She said the story is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ book had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the paper. The ⑧ book of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was three hundred pages and eleven years of reading; a book, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ book I remember is the one at the front, which was rebound in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ book, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being read; every book, she said, is a story that has agreed to look like a volume. She said the story was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 书（指那册书本身，与故事相对）
C. 固定搭配：bind a book 装订一本书
D. n. 书（指书架上每一本）
E. n. 书（指前面那一本）
F. n. 书（抽象：它所承载的那个故事）
G. n. 那个故事（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a book she could not read
The book, meaning the volume and not the story
book was the whole of the summer
the book had become a photograph in a report
The book of the whole thing
A book, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: bind a book 意为“装订一本书”，1947 年母亲被派去装订一本她读不懂的书。
book 意为“书”，指那册书本身而不是故事，共三百页，由最后走的人拿走。
book 指书架上每一本书，每一本都是同样的书脊。
book 指前面那一本（管理员留的那一本），是唯一有人认真修补过的。
book 意为“书”，抽象指它所承载的那个故事，父亲说 book 就是那个夏天的全部。
book 为抽象用法，指那个故事本身，是屋子里人人都借、却没人质疑的东西。
book 意为“书、书本”，到 1968 年这本 book 成了报告里的一张照片。
book 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是三百页纸和十一年的阅读。
book 意为“书”，我记得的是前面那一本，1974 年重新装订，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
book 为抽象总称，祖母说书是唯一会因为被阅读而变好的东西。
